items.title: M&G launches CDI+ run-on solution backed by £400m deal
items.summary: According to Professional Pensions, new offering combines asset management and insurance capabilities to give defined benefit pension schemes more flexibility.

items.title: UK shop price inflation accelerates to 2.1% in October
items.summary: According to Investment Week, the BRC Shop Price Monitor reports an increase in annual inflation as retailers contend with mounting cost pressures.

items.title: UK business financial distress reaches highest level in over twenty years
items.summary: According to The Guardian, insolvency firm BTG reports hundreds of thousands of struggling companies as pressure mounts on the chancellor ahead of the budget.

items.title: BlackRock survey reveals growing importance of strategic partnerships for insurers
items.summary: According to Reinsurance News, global study shows insurers increasingly seeking external partners that span investments, capital, liability and technology.

items.title: UK business insolvencies to decline in 2026, though structural pressures persist
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, allianz Trade forecasts a drop in business failures over the coming years, but warns that elevated levels and structural challenges remain.

items.title: Fortegra appoints Guy House as Senior Vice President of Treaty Reinsurance
items.summary: According to Reinsurance News, the specialty insurer has brought in the London market veteran to lead its treaty reinsurance underwriting strategy from the UK office.
